resources.string: Focale opens your photos from other apps
No default app: Android asks every time. Tap, then choose Focale and “Always”.
No default app: Android asks every time. Open a photo from another app, then choose Focale and “Always”.
%1$s opens your photos. Tap to choose Focale instead.

%1$s opens your photos by default. Android only lets you choose another app once its defaults are cleared: on its settings page, open “Open by default” (or “Set as default”) and clear them. Then come back to Focale and tap this setting again.
